KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. zito
   B. nene
   C. fupi
   D. pana

2. When practising Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Matamshi Bora Sauti, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Matamshi Bora Sauti.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Matamshi Bora Sauti.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Matamshi Bora Sauti.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Matamshi Bora Sauti.

3. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   D. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.

4. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. kitoto
   C. watoto
   D. mato
